context: Replaces permit! with an explicit strong-parameters allowlist on the articles API.
explanation: params.require(:article).permit! accepted every key sent in the request body, including any attribute a client cared to add — a mass assignment risk on any model with sensitive columns. The new article_params method whitelists exactly :title, :body, :status, and :published_at, so create and update can only ever set those four fields regardless of what else shows up in the payload. Clean, minimal, and testable.
